ex.en: This contract is null and void.
ex.zh: 這份合約無效。

ex.en: The agreement was declared null and void.
ex.zh: 這份協議被宣告無效。

ex.en: This field cannot be null.
ex.zh: 這個欄位不能是空值。

ex.en: A null value means the data is missing.
ex.zh: 空值表示資料缺漏。

null.en: having no value or containing nothing

ex.en: Please list the items in numerical order.
ex.zh: 請依數字順序列出這些項目。

ex.en: She has excellent numerical skills.
ex.zh: 她的數字能力很強。

ex.en: Maria knew neither his name nor his phone number.
ex.zh: 瑪莉亞既不知道他的名字，也不知道他的電話號碼。

ex.en: What's your phone number?
ex.zh: 你的電話號碼是幾號？

number.en: a figure used to identify something, such as a phone line

ex.en: One, three, and five are odd numbers.
ex.zh: 一、三、五都是奇數。

ex.en: Please write the number in the box.
ex.zh: 請把數字寫在格子裡。

number.en: a figure or word showing how many there are

ex.en: The number of tourists has increased.
ex.zh: 觀光客的人數增加了。

ex.en: The number of employees has doubled.
ex.zh: 員工人數增加了一倍。

number.en: the amount of people or things in a group

ex.en: The tomato is subject to a number of diseases.
ex.zh: 番茄容易感染好幾種病害。

ex.en: I've paid parking fines a number of times myself.
ex.zh: 我自己也被開過好幾次違規停車罰單。

number.en: several, or more than a few

ex.en: Nuclear power plants are dangerous, not to mention nuclear weapons.
ex.zh: 核電廠很危險，更別說核子武器了。

ex.en: We are in the age of nuclear energy.
ex.zh: 我們身處核能時代。

ex.en: All of us would like to get rid of nuclear weapons.
ex.zh: 我們都想廢除核子武器。

nuclear.en: using or relating to the energy from the center of atoms

ex.en: The nuclear family is common in big cities.
ex.zh: 小家庭在大城市很常見。

ex.en: A nuclear family includes parents and their children.
ex.zh: 核心家庭包括父母和子女。

nuclear.en: a family made up of parents and their children only

ex.en: Richard Roberts is the author of numerous books.
ex.zh: 理查·羅伯茲寫過許多本書。

ex.en: I have numerous books on my bookshelf.
ex.zh: 我的書架上有很多書。

ex.en: We have received numerous complaints about the noise.
ex.zh: 我們接到許多關於噪音的投訴。

ex.en: You two are the nucleus of the team.
ex.zh: 你們兩個是這個團隊的核心。

ex.en: These five engineers form the nucleus of the new department.
ex.zh: 這五位工程師是新部門的核心成員。

nucleus.en: the most important central part of a group or activity

ex.en: The nucleus controls the activities of the cell.
ex.zh: 細胞核控制細胞的活動。

ex.en: Protons and neutrons are found in the nucleus of an atom.
ex.zh: 質子和中子存在於原子核中。

nucleus.en: the central part of an atom or a living cell

ex.en: Vegetables are full of important nutrients.
ex.zh: 蔬菜富含重要的營養素。

ex.en: The soil lacks the nutrients plants need.
ex.zh: 這片土壤缺乏植物需要的養分。

nutrient.en: a substance that plants and animals need to live and grow

ex.en: The nurse will tell you how to do it.
ex.zh: 護理師會告訴你怎麼做。

ex.en: The nurse gently put a bandage around my head.
ex.zh: 護理師輕輕地幫我的頭包上繃帶。

ex.en: Those women are doctors, not nurses.
ex.zh: 那些女生是醫生，不是護理師。

nurse.en: a person trained to look after sick or injured people

ex.en: My father and I nursed my sister back to health after her accident.
ex.zh: 我妹妹出事之後，我和爸爸照顧她直到康復。

ex.en: She nursed her mother through a long illness.
ex.zh: 她照顧久病的母親。

nurse.en: to look after a sick or injured person

ex.en: She is careful about her child's nutrition.
ex.zh: 她很注意孩子的營養。

ex.en: Good nutrition is important for growing children.
ex.zh: 良好的營養對成長中的孩子很重要。

nutrition.en: the food that people need to stay healthy and grow

ex.en: The noisy neighbors have become a real nuisance to everyone on our street.
ex.zh: 那些吵鬧的鄰居已經成了我們這條街上每個人的困擾。

ex.en: I'm sorry to be a nuisance, but could you help me one more time?
ex.zh: 很抱歉給你添麻煩，但你可以再幫我一次嗎？

nuisance.en: a person or thing that annoys you or causes trouble

ex.en: Parents should nurture their children's curiosity.
ex.zh: 父母應該培養孩子的好奇心。

ex.en: It takes time and effort to nurture a friendship.
ex.zh: 經營一段友誼需要時間和心力。

nurture.en: to care for and help someone or something grow

ex.en: He is allergic to nuts, so he avoids cakes.
ex.zh: 他對堅果過敏，所以不吃蛋糕。

ex.en: Squirrels collect nuts before winter.
ex.zh: 松鼠在冬天來臨前收集堅果。

ex.en: She sprinkled chopped nuts on the ice cream.
ex.zh: 她在冰淇淋上撒了碎堅果。

ex.en: Tighten the nut with a wrench.
ex.zh: 用扳手把螺帽鎖緊。

ex.en: One nut fell off the bicycle wheel.
ex.zh: 腳踏車輪子上掉了一個螺帽。

ex.en: Her son goes to nursery three days a week.
ex.zh: 她的兒子每週去托兒所三天。

ex.en: The nursery has a big garden for children to play in.
ex.zh: 這間托兒所有一座大花園讓孩子玩耍。

ex.en: We bought some young trees from a local nursery.
ex.zh: 我們從當地的苗圃買了一些樹苗。

ex.en: The nursery sells flowers and vegetable seedlings.
ex.zh: 這個苗圃販售花卉和蔬菜幼苗。

ex.en: They painted the nursery light yellow before the baby arrived.
ex.zh: 寶寶出生前，他們把嬰兒房漆成淺黃色。

ex.en: She rocked the baby to sleep in the nursery.
ex.zh: 她在嬰兒房裡搖著寶寶入睡。

ex.en: She studied nursing at university.
ex.zh: 她在大學主修護理。

ex.en: Nursing is a demanding but rewarding job.
ex.zh: 護理工作辛苦但很有成就感。

ex.en: Nursing helps a mother bond with her baby.
ex.zh: 哺乳有助於母親與寶寶建立情感連結。

ex.en: She stopped nursing when her baby turned one.
ex.zh: 寶寶一歲時她就停止哺乳了。

ex.en: The nun taught music at the village school.
ex.zh: 那位修女在村裡的學校教音樂。

ex.en: A group of nuns walked quietly into the church.
ex.zh: 一群修女安靜地走進教堂。

ex.en: This cereal has high nutritional value.
ex.zh: 這種麥片的營養價值很高。

ex.en: The label shows the nutritional information of the food.
ex.zh: 標籤上標示了這種食物的營養資訊。

ex.en: She nudged me when the teacher walked by.
ex.zh: 老師走過時，她用手肘輕推了我一下。

ex.en: He nudged the door open with his foot.
ex.zh: 他用腳輕輕把門推開。

ex.en: My friend nudged me to apply for the job.
ex.zh: 朋友推了我一把，鼓勵我去應徵那份工作。

ex.en: A small reward can nudge people toward better habits.
ex.zh: 一點小獎勵可以促使人們養成更好的習慣。

ex.en: Give the cat a gentle nudge to wake it up.
ex.zh: 輕輕推一下那隻貓把牠叫醒。

ex.en: I just needed a little nudge to get started.
ex.zh: 我只是需要有人稍微推一把才開始行動。

ex.en: The translator captured every nuance of the poem.
ex.zh: 譯者捕捉到了這首詩的每一個細微差異。

ex.en: There is a small nuance between these two words.
ex.zh: 這兩個字之間有細微的差別。

ex.en: My fingers were numb from the cold.
ex.zh: 我的手指凍得失去了知覺。

ex.en: She felt numb after hearing the sad news.
ex.zh: 聽到那個壞消息後，她感到麻木。

ex.en: The dentist used a shot to numb my mouth.
ex.zh: 牙醫打了一針讓我的嘴巴麻掉。

ex.en: The cold wind numbed my face.
ex.zh: 冷風吹得我的臉都麻了。

ex.en: This bread has a rich, nutty flavor.
ex.zh: 這種麵包有濃郁的堅果香味。

ex.en: The brown rice tastes slightly nutty.
ex.zh: 糙米吃起來帶有一點堅果味。

ex.en: That's a nutty idea, but it might just work.
ex.zh: 那想法有點瘋狂，但說不定行得通。

ex.en: My uncle is a bit nutty, but everyone loves him.
ex.zh: 我叔叔有點怪怪的，但大家都喜歡他。

ex.en: Add a pinch of nutmeg to the cake mix.
ex.zh: 在蛋糕麵糊裡加一小撮肉豆蔻。

ex.en: The sauce tasted of cream and nutmeg.
ex.zh: 這道醬汁有奶油和肉豆蔻的味道。

nurturing.zh: 有養育力的；悉心培育的

ex.en: She grew up in a warm and nurturing family.
ex.zh: 她在一個溫暖又充滿關愛的家庭中長大。

ex.en: A teacher's job is to create a nurturing environment for students.
ex.zh: 老師的工作是為學生營造悉心照顧的學習環境。

nurturing.zh: 養育；培養（nurture 的現在分詞）

ex.en: They are nurturing young talent in the school.
ex.zh: 他們正在學校裡培育年輕的人才。

ex.en: She spent years nurturing the garden into a beautiful place.
ex.zh: 她花了多年時間悉心栽培，才把花園變得這麼漂亮。

ex.en: A nutritionist helped me plan healthier meals.
ex.zh: 一位營養師幫我規劃了更健康的餐點。

ex.en: The nutritionist told him to eat more vegetables.
ex.zh: 營養師叫他多吃一點蔬菜。

ex.en: Beans are a cheap and nutritious food.
ex.zh: 豆類是便宜又有營養的食物。

ex.en: She packs a nutritious lunch for her kids every morning.
ex.zh: 她每天早上都為孩子準備營養的午餐。

ex.en: DNA is made up of long chains of nucleotides.
ex.zh: DNA 由很長的核苷酸鏈組成。

ex.en: Each nucleotide contains a sugar, a phosphate, and a base.
ex.zh: 每個核苷酸都含有一個糖、一個磷酸和一個鹼基。

ex.en: The film was rated for adults because of brief nudity.
ex.zh: 這部電影因為有短暫的裸露鏡頭而被列為成人級。

ex.en: Some museums post a sign about nudity in the art.
ex.zh: 有些博物館會張貼告示說明展品中有裸體藝術。

ex.en: Each seat in the theater is numbered.
ex.zh: 劇院裡的每個座位都有編號。

ex.en: Please find the numbered box that matches your ticket.
ex.zh: 請找出與你的票相符的編號箱子。

ex.en: I added some nuts to the salad.
ex.zh: 我在沙拉裡加了一些堅果。

ex.en: Squirrels spend autumn collecting nuts.
ex.zh: 松鼠整個秋天都在收集堅果。

ex.en: You must be nuts to swim in this cold water.
ex.zh: 你一定是瘋了才會在這麼冷的水裡游泳。

ex.en: The noise is driving me nuts.
ex.zh: 這噪音快把我逼瘋了。

ex.en: He is nuts about soccer.
ex.zh: 他超愛足球。

ex.en: My sister is nuts about old movies.
ex.zh: 我姊姊超迷老電影。

ex.en: The two groups are numerically equal, with ten people each.
ex.zh: 兩組在數量上相等，各有十個人。

ex.en: Our team was numerically stronger, but they played better.
ex.zh: 我們隊在人數上比較佔優勢，但他們打得更好。

ex.en: The miner found a small gold nugget in the river.
ex.zh: 礦工在河裡發現一小塊金塊。

ex.en: A single nugget of gold can be worth a lot of money.
ex.zh: 一塊金塊就可能價值不菲。

ex.en: The kids ordered chicken nuggets for lunch.
ex.zh: 孩子們午餐點了雞塊。

ex.en: I dipped a nugget in sweet sauce.
ex.zh: 我把一塊雞塊沾了甜醬。

ex.en: The book is full of nuggets of useful advice.
ex.zh: 這本書裡充滿了實用的小建議。

ex.en: She shared a nugget of wisdom from her grandmother.
ex.zh: 她分享了祖母留下的一則智慧小語。

ex.en: In a nutshell, we need more time and more money.
ex.zh: 簡單說，我們需要更多時間和更多經費。

ex.en: Here is the whole story in a nutshell.
ex.zh: 整件事的重點就是這樣。

ex.en: The squirrel dropped a broken nutshell on the grass.
ex.zh: 松鼠把一片破掉的堅果殼丟在草地上。

ex.en: Children made tiny boats out of a nutshell.
ex.zh: 孩子們用堅果殼做了小小的船。

ex.en: She felt numbness in her fingers after sitting in the cold.
ex.zh: 她在寒冷中坐了一陣子後，手指感到麻木。

ex.en: The doctor asked if the numbness had spread to his arm.
ex.zh: 醫生問他麻木的感覺有沒有擴散到手臂。

ex.en: Nuremberg is a city in southern Germany.
ex.zh: 紐倫堡是德國南部的一座城市。

ex.en: We visited the Christmas market in Nuremberg last winter.
ex.zh: 我們去年冬天去逛了紐倫堡的聖誕市集。

ex.en: The judge may nullify the contract if it was signed under pressure.
ex.zh: 如果合約是在壓力下簽的，法官可能會宣告它無效。

ex.en: One careless mistake can nullify hours of careful work.
ex.zh: 一個粗心的錯誤就可能讓好幾個小時的用心工作白費。

ex.en: A numeric keypad makes it easy to type numbers.
ex.zh: 數字鍵盤讓輸入數字變得容易。

ex.en: The password must contain at least one numeric character.
ex.zh: 密碼必須至少包含一個數字字元。

ex.en: The leaders met to discuss how to reduce the number of nukes.
ex.zh: 領導人們開會討論如何減少核武器的數量。

ex.en: In the film, the hero has to stop a nuke from going off.
ex.zh: 電影裡，主角必須阻止一枚核彈爆炸。

nuke.zh: （口語）用微波爐加熱；用核武攻擊

ex.en: I'll just nuke the leftovers in the microwave.
ex.zh: 我只要把剩菜用微波爐熱一下就好。

ex.en: The game lets players nuke the enemy base.
ex.zh: 這款遊戲讓玩家可以用核彈轟炸敵方基地。

ex.en: The puppy nuzzled my hand, asking to be petted.
ex.zh: 小狗用鼻子磨蹭我的手，要我摸摸牠。

ex.en: The baby nuzzled against her mother's shoulder.
ex.zh: 寶寶依偎在媽媽的肩膀上。

ex.en: The clock uses Roman numerals instead of regular numbers.
ex.zh: 這座鐘使用羅馬數字而不是一般數字。

ex.en: Write the numeral seven on the board.
ex.zh: 在黑板上寫下數字七。
